correctness.rationale: Exact conditional factorial moments use an ordered list of prospective empty vertices outside a prescribed cycle and distinguish source choices within versus outside that list. The cycle event has probability (n-1)^-k; linearity yields exact (1) with no independence assumption between different cycles. Strict signs follow from g_n(2)>0, g_n(3)<0 and g_n(k+1)-g_n(k)<0 for all admissible k; exact k=3 cancellation establishes the anomalous n^-2 coefficient. Independent exhaustive small-size checks and rational sign checks all passed (40,314 assertions), with a separate analytic proof for every n.

value.rationale: Loopless mappings are a standard and motivated functional-digraph model; their cycle lengths represent basic distinct feedback circuit types and indegree-zero vertices represent sources. The theorem gives a complete sign phase diagram and new conditional factorial law, with an unexpected positive two-cycle covariance opposite to all other lengths and a singled-out three-cycle with n^-2 rather than n^-1 dependence. A comparison proves the positive regime disappears if self-images are allowed. This is a structural dependence boundary, not a single arbitrary sampled parameter or mere numeric calculation.
